fichas.title: Sports hall types and playing areas
fichas.summary: The page compares multi-functional halls and sports halls by hall dimensions, usable playing area, sports accommodated, and training and competition court counts. Subdividable halls are described as preferable for flexibility. The site-size estimate is stated as required sports area × 2 plus open areas to the site boundary and vehicle parking.
